one_line: Sultan of Bijapur and poet-musician of the Deccan, blending Persian and Indian arts at the turn of the 17th century.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, medium height, slightly stocky but graceful, with the calm bearing of a contemplative ruler.
appearance.face: Oval face with a gently defined jaw, wheatish-brown Deccan complexion, neatly trimmed pointed black beard and moustache, expressive almond-shaped dark brown eyes with slightly thick brows; default expression is serene and introspective, a soft half‑smile as if listening to music.
appearance.hair: Black hair kept short and tidy beneath a tall rounded Deccani turban (kulah) in deep emerald green, wrapped with a cream band and topped by a small central gold finial and a single white heron feather angled slightly backward.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, fitted Deccani jama (coat) of fine off‑white cotton silk reaching mid‑calf, fastened diagonally to the right with small gold buttons, the fabric subtly patterned with pale gold floral jaal; over it a sleeveless dark teal velvet overcoat with narrow gold braid along the edges; around his waist a broad saffron‑orange silk patka (sash) with thin red and gold stripes, tied in a knot with the ends hanging at his left side; he has slim cream churidar trousers with soft folds at the ankles and simple brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes, lightly embroidered in gold; accessories include a thin gold necklace with a small round green stone pendant, a couple of slim gold rings, and a dark red wool shawl with simple gold border draped over his left shoulder when at rest.
appearance.signature: A tanpura-like long-necked lute in polished dark wood with an inlaid ivory floral rosette on the gourd and a red silk tassel at the base, held close as both royal emblem and instrument of devotion.

ref_desc: Ibrahim Adil Shah II has an oval wheatish face with trimmed black beard and calm dark eyes, short black hair under an emerald Deccani turban, wearing an off‑white patterned jama, dark teal overcoat, saffron sash, cream churidar, brown mojari, and carrying a dark wood tanpura‑like lute.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model sheet of Ibrahim Adil Shah II: a late‑30s Deccan sultan with an oval wheatish face, neatly trimmed pointed black beard and moustache, expressive dark brown almond eyes and a serene, introspective half‑smile. His short black hair is covered by a tall rounded emerald green Deccani turban wrapped with a cream band, topped with a small gold finial and one white heron feather tilted back. He wears a long off‑white cotton silk jama reaching mid‑calf, fastening diagonally to the right with small gold buttons, the cloth subtly patterned in pale gold floral jaal; over this sits a sleeveless dark teal velvet overcoat edged in narrow gold braid. Around his waist is a broad saffron‑orange silk patka with thin red and gold stripes, knotted so the ends hang at his left hip. His legs are covered by slim cream churidar trousers that bunch in soft folds at the ankles, and on his feet are simple brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes and light gold embroidery. Show a thin gold necklace with a small round green stone pendant, a couple of slim gold rings, and optionally a dark red wool shawl with a simple gold border draped over his left shoulder in some views. His signature prop is a polished dark‑wood tanpura‑like long‑necked lute with an inlaid ivory floral rosette on the gourd and a red silk tassel at the base, which he holds with quiet reverence. Use a palette of off‑white, emerald green, dark teal, saffron orange and brown leather, and present him in front, side and back views to clarify his fixed face, turban, garments and instrument.
